hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A palindromic integer reads the same forwards and backwards in base 10.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For each element in nums, generate nearby palindromic candidates by mirroring prefix digits.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Take the candidate with minimal absolute distance and accumulate total conversion costs.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Palindrome reflection candidates evaluated per number with d digits.
